WITH RECURSIVE lineage AS (
            SELECT id, parent_job, kind, runnable_path, trigger_kind, 0 AS depth
            FROM v2_job WHERE id = $1 AND workspace_id = $2
          UNION ALL
            SELECT p.id, p.parent_job, p.kind, p.runnable_path, p.trigger_kind, l.depth + 1
            FROM v2_job p JOIN lineage l ON p.id = l.parent_job
            WHERE p.workspace_id = $2 AND l.depth < 100
        )
        SELECT l.id AS "id!", l.parent_job, l.kind AS "kind!: windmill_common::jobs::JobKind",
            l.runnable_path, l.trigger_kind::text AS trigger_kind,
            -- A restart takes its flow version from the request, so a trusted flow path
            -- can carry another flow's code: the version must belong to that path.
            CASE l.kind
                WHEN 'flow' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flow_version fv
                    WHERE fv.id = j.runnable_id AND fv.path = l.runnable_path AND fv.workspace_id = $2)
                WHEN 'script' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM script s
                    WHERE s.hash = j.runnable_id AND s.path = l.runnable_path AND s.workspace_id = $2)
                ELSE true
            END AS "version_matches_path!"
        FROM lineage l JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = l.id ORDER BY l.depth
